tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search current Empryo documentation. Returns exact page and section selectors and citation URLs.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List Empryo documentation pages, or the sections and export URLs of one page.

tools.name: read_docs
tools.description: Read a full Empryo docs page or an exact section as Markdown or plain text. Use selectors returned by search_docs/list_docs; empty anchor means introduction.

tools.name: current_release
tools.description: Read the current published Empryo version and available release artifacts. Never assumes the installed client matches this version.
